note: GD.21 (FD.62; seed §E W3 DH.5, DH.10): the env and CLI residuals. Dart `String.fromEnvironment` / `Platform.environment.containsKey` and Elixir `Application.get_env` were unread; PHP's global `exec(` was no needle (cli.rs said so: a bare exec would read JS `regex.exec(..)`), so it is read in .php files only, outside a `->exec(` / `::exec(` member call; a fully qualified Symfony Process was unread (the `new Process(` needle needs the bare class). Also package:args `aliases`, pubspec `executables:` and gemspec `executables.concat(..)` / `+=`. Baseline at cb9334e5 (debug CLI merge, the pre-change binary): every expect node and edge missing (no CONFIG_KEY or CLI_INVOCATION at all; CLI_COMMAND only sync, envtool, thumbs); both forbid rows already pass (no bare exec needle at HEAD), kept as regression guards.
